IGUI_tooltip_GunFighter_option132:

- When In-Game, [Mag-Type_1 Hot-Key] will Toggle this option

- This was coded with the idea that we want to Run thru all currently selected Mag-Types before switching
IGUI_tooltip_GunFighter_option133:

IGUI_tooltip_GunFighter_option134:
